arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'tmp');sys.path.insert(0,'deps')
src=open('tmp/cost_scaling.py').read().split("if __name__=='__main__':")[0]
src=src.replace('return flow,dt,rounds','return flow,dt,rounds,G,price')
ns={};exec(src,ns)
pairs=[(8, 8, 12), (5, 5, 46), (2, 3, 6), (2, 4, 12), (2, 9, 9), (1, 2, 49), (7, 7, 48), (7, 10, 36), (5, 10, 20), (2, 7, 4), (4, 4, 37), (0, 5, 32), (1, 4, 29)]
flow,dt,rounds,G,price=ns['solve_assignment'](9,11,pairs,costmax=49)
E=len(G.to);ts=E-2
from collections import deque
S=0;T=1
par={S:None};q=deque([S])
while q:
 u=q.popleft()
 for e in G.g[u]:
  if e==ts or e==ts+1:continue
  if G.cap[e]>0:
   v=G.to[e]
   if v not in par:par[v]=(u,e);q.append(v)
print('assignment S->T residual path?',T in par)
if T in par:
 path=[];x=T
 while par[x] is not None:
  u,e=par[x];path.append((u,x,e,G.cap[e],G.cost[e]*(G.n+1)+price[u]-price[x]));x=u
 print(list(reversed(path)))
# reduced ts
print('ts e',ts,'flow',G.initial[ts]-G.cap[ts],'rescap',G.cap[ts],'rc',G.cost[ts]*(G.n+1)+price[G.fr[ts]]-price[G.to[ts]])
EOF
